brief: Web poster first screen for a November jazz festival: 5-act line-up, dates and venue, early-bird ticket CTA. Night, neon, warm brass mood.

diagnosis: Place areas (PPA/RSC) dominate: the background scene swallows the message
Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
Face areas (FFA/STS) are silent: no human or gaze cue
Reward circuit (OFC/vmPFC) is on but the appeal head is average: value is felt but what is good isn't legible

judge.reason: Polished brass-noir system nails the brief content and mood but splits focus between oversized type, illustration, and dense lineup while mixing Nocturne vs Midnight naming.

directives: Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
